analysis: The method checkState throws an IllegalStateException only when MediaLibraryInfo.ASSERTIONS_ENABLED is true and the expression evaluates to false. The condition mimics an assertion mechanism: it checks a boolean expression and throws an exception if it fails, but only in a debug or assertion-enabled mode. The use of @Pure indicates no side effects. The throw is intended as a fail-fast mechanism for programming errors (precondition violations), not as part of normal control flow. Typically, such assertions are not expected to be caught by callers; they should propagate to indicate a bug in the program logic.
remark: The throw occurs only when assertions are enabled (MediaLibraryInfo.ASSERTIONS_ENABLED) and the expression is false. The programmer expects this exception to stop execution or be logged by a top-level handler, not to be caught and handled by the immediate caller as part of normal error recovery.
